definitions.definition:
‘AI system’ means a machine-based system that is designed to operate with varying levels of
autonomy and that may exhibit adaptiveness after deployment, and that, for explicit or implicit
objectives, infers, from the input it receives, how to generate outputs such as predictions, content,
recommendations, or decisions that can influence physical or virtual environments;

‘general-purpose AI model’ means an AI model, including where such an AI model is trained with
a large amount of data using self-supervision at scale, that displays significant generality and is
capable of competently performing a wide range of distinct tasks regardless of the way the model is
placed on the market and that can be integrated into a variety of downstream systems or
applications, except AI models that are used for research, development or prototyping activities
before they are placed on the market;

note: Article 6 sets classification rules for high-risk AI systems but gives no 'high-risk AI system' definition in Article 3, so that group is not found. Article 3(66) defines 'general-purpose AI system' (not a plan group).
